factoryData.readme:
# Knowledge / memory modules

Per-vertical corpora the apps and agents draw on. One folder per domain; each file names its
source and how it's used in its own header.

Seeded corpora:
- `color-theory/`
  - `color-theory.md` — full color reference (properties, harmonies, the 7-step palette process,
    60-30-10, accessibility, color meanings, cultural cautions). Source: `Color Theory.pdf`.
  - `seasons.md` — the seasonal-analysis subset used by the Color Matching app.
- `wireframing/`
  - `wireframing-theory.md` — full wireframing theory. Source: `Wireframing.pdf`.
  - `wireframing.md` — curated flow-rules / iOS-pattern cheat-sheet.
- `composition/`
  - `composition-theory.md` — full composition reference (composition types, elements and their
    properties, contrast, similarity, repetition, rhythm, balance, hierarchy, grids, Gestalt,
    focal points) applied to UI/screen design. Source: `Design Composition.pdf`.
  - `AppleComposition-guidelines.md` — full transcript of Apple's WWDC25 "Get to know the new
    design system" session (Liquid Glass, concentricity, structure, continuity).
    Source: youtube.com/watch?v=DS2ildqCrB0.
- `apple-guidelines/`
  - `app-store-review-guidelines.md` — the full App Store Review Guidelines (all five sections).
    Source: developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/.

As verticals grow we merge and reuse rather than re-collecting.

localOverrides.description: Organizes reusable, source-aware knowledge by domain so agents and applications can retrieve consistent guidance and reference material.
